job.title: Senior Android Engineer, Event Contracts
job.workplace: In office at least 3 days a week
job.pay_full: $196,000 – $230,000 a year base pay (Zone 1, including New York), plus bonus opportunities, equity and benefits

details.about: Robinhood's Event Contracts team, part of Prediction Markets, builds the customer experiences for discovering, accessing and trading Event Contracts, including the Predict tab, prediction markets hub surfaces and related account and funding flows. The role is based in the New York City office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days a week.
duties: Build mobile experiences with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and modern Android APIs
Lead product features from ideation and technical design to implementation, testing and release
Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, Backend Engineers and Data Scientists
Champion engineering best practices for quality, scalability and maintainability
needs: 6+ years of professional experience developing Android applications
Proficiency with Kotlin and/or Java, and a strong grasp of the Android SDK and architecture patterns like MVVM
Experience with Jetpack Compose, Coroutines & Flow or RxJava, and libraries such as Retrofit and Room
Strong collaboration and communication skills with a product-focused mindset
Demonstrated ability to mentor peers, lead complex projects and influence architecture decisions
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
details.benefits: Base pay $196,000 – $230,000 a year in Zone 1 (Menlo Park, New York, Bellevue, Washington DC), plus bonus opportunities, equity and benefits. Offerings include 401(k) matching, 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents, a lifestyle wallet spending account, employer-paid life and disability insurance, fertility benefits, mental health support, company holidays, PTO, sick time, parental leave, catered meals and commuter benefits.
notes: In-person attendance at the New York City office at least 3 days a week
